title: SlugBleed, DSFFAKW, Rat Kingdom @ BOX BOY VINTAGE

description: This is a live music show featuring Alabama Slam band SlugBleed, Deep Sea Fishing For A Killer Whale, and Rat Kingdom, held to support SlugBleed as they play shows across the country. It is all ages, and admission is $5 or pay what you can. It takes place November 29, 2026, Time TBD, at Box Boy Vintage, 1619 S Main Street in Joplin, Missouri.
